providers.title: Run a towing or roadside business?
providers.body: Get paid jobs from drivers near you. Set your own prices, quote when you want, and pay a flat fee only when a driver picks you.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: Drivers get quotes from nearby providers and choose one. Providers get paid jobs and set their own prices.
driverSteps: Choose the problem (flat tire, dead battery, lockout, fuel or tow) and share your location. No account needed.
Verified providers near you send a full price and their arrival time, usually within about 3 minutes.
Pick the quote you want and follow the provider on the way. You pay the provider directly when the job is done.
providerSteps: When a driver near you needs a service you offer, you get the request with the location and details.
Set your own price and arrival time. Quote the jobs you want, skip the ones you don't.
If the driver picks you, you get their details and do the job. The driver pays you directly; we charge a flat fee from your prepaid wallet.
how.payBody: Drivers pay providers directly for the job. Providers pay us a flat fee per picked request from a prepaid wallet. We never handle the job payment.

faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.intro: Answers about getting help, prices, safety and joining as a provider.

drivers: What can I get help with?
Flat tires, dead batteries, lockouts, running out of fuel and towing. Some cities add more services over time.
Do I need an account or membership?
No. You request help when you need it, with no sign-up and no membership.
Each quote shows the provider's arrival time, so you can choose the fastest.
We open city by city. The cities menu at the top lists every city we serve today.
prices: Providers quote a full price before you choose. City pages show typical local price ranges.
You pay the provider directly when the job is done, by the payment methods they accept. We never charge you for the job.
The quote is the price for the service. Some services add a clear extra, like the fuel itself or towing distance, and the quote says so.
safety: What should I do while I wait?
Move off the road if you safely can, turn on your hazard lights, and on a highway stay in your vehicle with your seatbelt on. If you are in danger, call 911.
We check insurance and, where required, licenses (for example TDLR towing licenses in Texas) before a provider can quote.
Can I see who is coming?
Yes. You see the provider's company name and can follow their arrival once you choose them.
providers: Apply on the For providers page. We check your insurance and license, then you can start quoting.
A flat fee per request where the driver picks you, paid from a prepaid wallet. Optional plans add discounts and featured placement.
Do I set my own prices?
Yes. You quote each job at your price.

safetyPage.title: Safety tips
safetyPage.intro: What to do when your vehicle breaks down. If anyone is hurt or in danger, call 911 first.
sections: Get to a safe place
If the vehicle still moves, take the next exit or pull as far onto the shoulder as you can, away from curves and hills. Turn on your hazard lights.
On a highway
Stay in your vehicle with your seatbelt on unless it is safer to get out. If you get out, use the side away from traffic and stand behind a barrier if there is one.
At night
Keep hazard lights and interior lights on so other drivers and your provider can see you. Share your location with someone you trust.
In heat
Keep water with you, stay in the shade or in the car with air conditioning if it is safe, and watch for signs of heat illness.
In floods
Never drive into a flooded road. Turn around. If water is rising around your vehicle, get out to higher ground and call 911.
When help arrives
Check the provider's name matches the one you chose. Agree on the price before work starts. Pay the provider directly.

driver-terms.title: Driver Terms of Use
driver-terms.intro: These terms apply when you use our website or phone line to request roadside help.
sections: We are a marketplace, not a roadside provider

We connect you with independent roadside providers. We do not tow, repair, unlock or deliver fuel ourselves, and providers are not our employees or agents. The provider you choose is responsible for the work.
Quotes and prices

Providers set their own prices. A quote is the provider's offer for the service described. Some services list extras, such as fuel or towing distance. Confirm the price with the provider before work starts.
Payment
You pay the provider directly, using the payment methods they accept. We do not charge you for the job and do not handle the job payment.
Your information
You agree to give accurate details about your location, vehicle and problem, and to let us share them with providers so they can quote and help you. See the Privacy Policy.
Safety and emergencies
Our service is not an emergency service. If anyone is hurt or in danger, call 911 first.
Ratings and conduct
Treat providers with respect. Ratings and reviews must be honest and about your own experience.
Limits of our responsibility
To the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for the provider's work, delays, damage or pricing. Disputes about a job are between you and the provider, though we will try to help.
Changes and contact
We may update these terms. The version and date are shown above. Contact us with any questions.

provider-terms.title: Provider Terms
provider-terms.intro: These terms apply to roadside providers who join the marketplace.
sections: Joining and verification
You must hold the insurance and licenses required for the services you offer (for example a TDLR tow operator license in Texas), keep them current and send proof when asked.
Quotes and jobs
You choose which requests to quote. A quote must include the full price for the service and an honest arrival time. If a driver picks you, you agree to do the job as quoted.
Fees
When a driver picks your quote, a flat fee for that city and service is charged to your prepaid wallet. Current fees are shown on the For Providers page and in your portal.
Wallet and credits

You top up your wallet in advance. Fees are taken from the balance. Credits we issue (for example for a cancelled job that was not your fault) are added to the wallet. Unused balances are handled as described in your portal.
Plans
Optional Pro and Featured plans are billed monthly at the price shown for your city and can be cancelled before the next billing date.
Payment from drivers
Drivers pay you directly. You are responsible for your own payment processing, receipts and taxes.
Conduct
Be honest, safe and courteous. No overcharging against your quote, no harassment, no unsafe work.
Suspension and removal
We may pause or remove a provider for lapsed insurance or licenses, repeated no-shows, complaints, fraud or breaking these terms. We tell you the reason and the next step.
Changes and contact
We may update these terms and fees with notice. The version and date are shown above.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How we collect, use and share personal information, and the choices you have.
sections: What we collect
Contact details (name, phone, email), your location and vehicle details when you request help, messages you send us, device and usage data, and for providers, business, insurance and license details.
How we use it
To connect you with providers, send updates about your request, prevent fraud, keep the service safe, improve it and meet legal duties.
Who we share it with

With the providers who quote or do your job, with service companies that help us run the service (hosting, messaging, email), and when the law requires it. We do not sell personal information for money.
Cookies and similar technologies
We use necessary cookies to run the site. Analytics and advertising cookies are used only with your consent. See the Cookie Policy and "Your privacy choices".
California residents

You can ask to know, delete or correct your personal information, and to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information and of targeted advertising. We honor Global Privacy Control signals. We will not discriminate against you for using these rights.
Texas, Nevada and Florida residents

Depending on your state, you can ask to access, correct or delete your personal data, get a copy of it, and opt out of targeted advertising, sale or profiling. Nevada residents can opt out of the sale of covered information.
How to make a request
Use the contact page and choose "Privacy request", or email us. We will verify your request and reply within the time the law requires. You can appeal a decision by replying to our answer.
Retention and security
We keep information only as long as needed for these purposes and legal duties, and protect it with technical and organizational safeguards.
Children
The service is not for children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their information.
Changes and contact
We will post changes here with a new version and date.

sms-terms.title: SMS Terms
sms-terms.intro: Terms for text messages about your requests and applications.
sections: What you will receive
Messages about your roadside request (quotes, the provider's arrival, status) or your provider application. Message frequency varies with your activity.
How you opt in
By giving your mobile number and checking the opt-in box (or by texting us), you agree to receive these messages. Consent is not a condition of any purchase.
Opt out and help
Reply STOP to stop messages at any time. Reply HELP for help, or contact us.
Costs
Message and data rates may apply, depending on your mobile plan.
Carriers
Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.
Privacy
We use your number as described in the Privacy Policy and do not share it for third-party marketing.

call-recording.title: Call Recording Notice
call-recording.intro: Calls to and from our phone numbers may be recorded.
sections: Why we record
To help you quickly, check quality, train our team, resolve disputes and prevent fraud.
Notice and consent

When you call us, a message tells you the call may be recorded before the conversation starts. Some states require everyone on the call to agree; continuing the call means you agree. If you do not want to be recorded, tell us and we will help another way, for example by text or the website.
Keeping recordings
Recordings are kept only as long as needed for these purposes and then deleted, unless the law requires us to keep them longer.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: How we use cookies and similar technologies, and how to control them.
sections: Necessary
Needed for the site to work: your chosen area, language, security checks and your privacy choices. These are always on.
Analytics
Help us understand how the site is used so we can improve it. Only with your consent.
Advertising
Measure our ads and show relevant ads on other sites. Only with your consent, and never when your browser sends a Global Privacy Control signal.
Your choices
Use "Your privacy choices" in the footer to change your settings at any time. We use Google Consent Mode, so Google tags stay off until you agree.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: We want everyone to be able to get roadside help on our website.
sections: Our goal
We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA.
What we do
We test with keyboard only and screen readers, use clear contrast in light and dark mode, large touch targets and plain language, and check every page automatically before release.
Known limits
Maps may not be fully accessible; you can always type an address or call instead.
Feedback
If something is hard to use, tell us through the contact page and we will help and fix it.
